 Mckenna Grace Flashes Underwear in Sheer Lacy Micro Minidress & Louboutins
 November 11, 2026 
 By
 Viha Shah 
 Mckenna Grace is turning up the heat with another daring fashion moment. The actress stepped out for a Cultured Magazine event in Los Angeles, making a statement with her latest all-black ensemble. Styled by Molly Dickson, Grace embraced the sheer-dressing trend with a look that left little to the imagination.
 Mckenna Grace’s underwear is on full display in sheer lacy micro minidress and Christian Louboutin heels
 View this post on Instagram 
 For the occasion, Mckenna Grace slipped into a sheer lacy micro minidress by Annie’s Ibiza that put her underwear on full display. The black dress featured intricate floral lace embroidery layered over a transparent base, creating a striking contrast against her skin. Its fitted silhouette hugged her figure, while the barely-there fabric offered glimpses of the lingerie underneath.
 The underwear pairing with the sheer lacy micro minidress was undoubtedly the highlight of her appearance. While the floral embroidery provided some coverage, the transparent panels across the bodice, waist, hips, and back made the outfit particularly daring. The actress also wore a matching black lace choker, bringing the entire look together.
 Grace paired the revealing minidress with Christian Louboutin heels, which were tagged in the Instagram post. The black pointed-toe pumps featured a sleek silhouette that complemented the dress without distracting from its intricate detailing. The choice of footwear also added a polished touch to the risky ensemble.
 For her beauty look, Grace traded her previous sleek updo for long, tousled blonde waves with soft bangs framing her face. She opted for rosy cheeks, defined lashes, and a nude-pink lip, keeping her makeup relatively understated.
 Stylist Molly Dickson shared several photographs of the outfit on Instagram, crediting Annie’s Ibiza for the dress. The images showed Grace posing against a sheer curtain backdrop, including a photograph from behind that highlighted the dress’s extremely transparent construction.
 The Cultured Magazine event appearance showcased a different side of the actress’s fashion choices, combining delicate lace, a daring micro hemline, and classic designer heels for a memorable evening look.
